headline: US and Turkmenistan Discuss Trans-Caspian Energy Export Routes
summary: US and Turkmen officials held consultations in Ashgabat to explore expanding trans-Caspian connectivity and diversifying energy export routes. The discussions focused on improving trade ties between Turkmenistan, South Asia, and Western markets.
why: Turkmenistan holds some of the world's largest natural gas reserves. Diversifying export routes away from traditional pipelines is a significant geopolitical and economic objective for both the country and international energy markets.

impacts.name: Turkmenistan
impacts.why: Potential for new export infrastructure could alter the country's long-term economic outlook.
